verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a central credential store whose connection credentials can be shared with teammates and permissioned per credential. Connectors are added to individual agents, and the agent Owner/User roles, team-scoped Gumloop API keys, and the Slack organization service account are adjacent controls, not credential sharing or credential-level access control.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential
